goal: 1.5x–3x same-request committed Decode, drafts2/3, exact target verifier unchanged
decision_unit: bounded host numerical feasibility, no runtime selection

downward_budget.limitation: Even complete draft elimination cannot close remaining 40K gap; any useful dependency must compose with further verifier work.

proposal: One fixed symmetric per-output-channel INT8 rounding of eight BF16 draft matrices, BF16 positive scales, codes -127..127 (packed U8B128). Norms unchanged. Compare complete teacher-forced P65 draft hidden/K/V with independently evaluated original FP64 layer at unchanged BF16 publication boundaries and 0.02 maximum-row relative L2 screen.
contract: This is not authorization to alter target arithmetic, production accuracy or reduce the existing draft numerical bound. A host pass is feasibility only; a runtime successor must receive its own numerical identity, preserve exact within-route draft-cache replay, evaluate natural acceptance and return promptly to real d2/d3 API.
reference: Vendored vLLM Marlin dequant.h supports kU8B128 BF16 operand decoding; this is source feasibility, not SM87 performance evidence. No imported code/runtime dependency is added.

bounds.scales: BF16 per output channel, no group-size or quantization scan

exit: Fail closes this fixed quantizer; pass permits selecting one separately bounded native owner/consumer/API composition, no speedup claim from CPU errors.
